annotationMethod: Rule applicability is reviewed independently from pixel acquisition; no executable rule or generated report supplies these labels.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does the artwork contain a UI/UX defect?
cases.rationale: The case exists only to exercise bounded acquisition behavior.

cases.semanticQuestion: Do acquired surfaces establish a UI/UX defect at this device scale?
cases.rationale: Pixel regions do not define a normative design obligation.

cases.semanticQuestion: Is the edge status indicator a defect?
cases.rationale: The mutation targets acquisition coverage; the indicator may be intentional.

cases.semanticQuestion: Should gradient layers be treated as repeated foreground UI objects?
cases.rationale: The illustration is an intentional hard negative for one global exact background.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does the visible modal geometry prove an interaction or layout defect?
cases.rationale: Pixels do not reveal modal interaction, focus, or obscured-content semantics.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does exact recoloring prove a color or contrast defect?
cases.rationale: No color-management, compositing, or contrast policy is present.

cases.semanticQuestion: Is either intentional pane a foreground defect?
cases.rationale: Both source-authored panes are valid top-level surfaces; a frequency winner is not a semantic error.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does translating the surface layout establish a defect?
cases.rationale: The benchmark checks acquisition stability, not preferred placement.

cases.semanticQuestion: Do the acquired regions prove semantic card grouping or a UI/UX defect?
cases.rationale: Source-authored visible surfaces are acquisition targets only.
